purpose: the circle of latitude 45 S as a 2-D ring, the Sun crossing it once a lunar day, seas and lakes of the 28% scenario at sea level, land as wet as the GCM's there, the 3% dimmer shield, the corrected radiation's design case's row nearest the latitude as reference, and its mean vertical wind there imposed as large-scale vertical advection, with the curved air's twilight and side light (climate/results/gcm/twilight.json)
evidence: CM1's own state: rain mass and number in every 3-D output of the span, read as Morrison's exponential spectrum. It says where the scheme puts the rain's sizes under its limits; it measures no drop.
reading_rule: Diameters in mm. mass_share gives the share of the rain's mass (grid cells with rain above 1e-8 kg/kg, weighted by rain mass per square metre) whose mean diameter 1/lambda lies in each bin of edges_mm. limits are the case's own (cm1_run.rain_limits). at_cap is the share within 0.5% of the cap on the mean diameter; held_cells describes those cells and all rain cells by rain content (g/m3) and height (km above the model's ground).
